description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_match UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/matches, or its /:id/withdraw); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the sponsor wallet. An offer moves no NET and holds none. Ask net_match_status where it stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
